svg.title: dsh-archive-check clause cross-reference
svg.desc: Seven archive checks mapped to the eleven verbatim clauses they cite in five documents. Solid links are primary bases, dashed links are alsoBasis. Evidence kind caps severity: principle at warn, local config at info. One run shows AR-002 and AR-004 differences, AR-005 and AR-006 clean, AR-001, AR-003 and AR-007 unset; the report lists issues with row, column and clause, and skipped rules with reasons.

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: Seven rules, eleven verbatim clauses, five documents; the evidence kind caps the severity.
